rule: Written by the builder's AI assistant, not an independent test. Messages and labels were committed before any run; prompts are frozen and no code changes in response to this set before its live run.

labels.routine: nothing to check: ForgeEmber should not interrupt the owner (risk LOW)
labels.check: a genuine message that still needs a check (risk MEDIUM or HIGH)

items.label: routine
items.message: A friendly overdue reminder from a known supplier's domain
items.why: it refers to an invoice already on file and asks for nothing new

items.label: routine
items.message: A 'FINAL REMINDER' with a late fee, from a known supplier
items.why: urgent in tone, but pay to the account on the invoice as usual

items.label: routine
items.message: A supplier's statement listing three invoices
items.why: a summary of invoices already on file; nothing new to pay or change

items.label: routine
items.message: An ordinary invoice PDF from a known supplier
items.why: account on file, usual amount: approve when it's due

items.label: routine
items.message: A supplier announcing a price rise from January
items.why: information only; nothing to pay now

items.label: routine
items.message: A courier's snow-delay notice
items.why: information only

items.label: routine
items.message: The owner forwards a supplier's invoice from her own address
items.why: the owner's real address, a known supplier's usual invoice

items.label: routine
items.message: A customer's remittance advice (money coming in)
items.why: nothing to pay

items.label: routine
items.message: An 'URGENT' customer order
items.why: a sale, not a payment

items.label: routine
items.message: A hosting provider's password-expiry notice with a login link
items.why: from the provider's own domain, the link is on that domain, and no money moves

items.label: routine
items.message: The accountant asking for receipts
items.why: a new sender, but no money and nothing sensitive

items.label: routine
items.message: The bank saying a statement is ready
items.why: no link, no money, no request

items.label: routine
items.message: A credit note in the business's favour
items.why: money owed to us

items.label: routine
items.message: An invoice quoting a purchase order
items.why: account on file, usual amount: approve when it's due

items.label: routine
items.message: A supplier's sale newsletter
items.why: marketing

items.label: routine
items.message: An out-of-office reply
items.why: information only

items.label: routine
items.message: The owner, from her own address, asks to pay a known invoice early
items.why: a known invoice to the account on file; only the timing changes

items.label: routine
items.message: A corrected invoice with a lower total (returns credited)
items.why: account on file, usual amount; on its own, an ordinary invoice

items.label: check
items.message: A genuine bank change from a known supplier, asking you to call to confirm
items.why: any bank change must be confirmed on the number on file, genuine or not

items.label: check
items.message: A genuine invoice far above the supplier's usual amount
items.why: check it against the order before paying

items.label: check
items.message: A first invoice from a new supplier
items.why: check you ordered from them before paying a new payee

items.label: check
items.message: A known supplier says its accounts email is changing domain
items.why: a contact-detail change: confirm by phone before trusting the new address

items.label: check
items.message: A genuine invoice whose subtotal is wrong
items.why: ask for a corrected invoice before paying

items.label: check
items.message: A driver's voicemail asking for a redelivery fee by card
items.why: a payment asked for by voice: call back on the number on file

items.label: check
items.message: The owner, from her own address, asks to pay a new contractor today
items.why: a new payee and new bank details: confirm with the owner in person
